verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents Perplexity-hosted built-in tools that include dedicated "people and finance search" alongside general web search, so at least one vertical (finance) can be targeted as its own tool. Nothing in the pack shows news or image verticals, or vertical/category filters on the raw Search API, which only documents domain filtering. Missing for 10: news vertical or filter, image search vertical, category filters on the Search API, in-depth docs on finance search parameters, independent corroboration.
